comments: The entry No. 16070 in [8H6M69W4] (mdzod kyi gnas gsal bar byed pa zla ba' 'od zer; dge slong blo gros seng ge; 38 fols.) corresponds to the manuscript of (ID:4535), (ID:5893), and (ID:7304), which are written with continuous folio numbering. This text is found on fols. 32a7-38a7.
